toolsPreview.name: list_products
toolsPreview.description: List all Dataplex healthcare data products: CMS provider, facility, nursing home and prior authorization compliance data, FDA adverse events (FAERS/MAUDE), CDC public health statistics, NPPES NPI provider records, hospital and Medicaid spending. Returns slug, name, one-liner, price, and links for each.

toolsPreview.name: search_health_datasets
toolsPreview.description: Search Dataplex healthcare datasets by keyword (e.g. 'nursing home compliance', 'prior authorization CMS-0057', 'FDA adverse events', 'NPI provider', 'CDC mortality'). Matches product names, descriptions and table names; returns matching products.

toolsPreview.name: get_product_details
toolsPreview.description: Full metadata for one Dataplex product: description, tables, update frequency, price, docs, Snowflake Marketplace listing.

toolsPreview.name: get_data_dictionary
toolsPreview.description: Tables and validated example SQL queries for one Dataplex product — enough to plan an analysis before subscribing.

toolsPreview.name: get_sample_data
toolsPreview.description: 100 REAL rows from a Dataplex product's primary table — the same governed views sold on Snowflake and Databricks. No signup needed. Use this to evaluate schema and content quality.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: Machine-readable pricing for all Dataplex products: monthly price, free-trial link, Snowflake Marketplace listing URL.

toolsPreview.name: get_snowflake_trial_sql
toolsPreview.description: Copy-paste SQL for an agent INSIDE a Snowflake account to mount a Dataplex listing and start querying trial data in minutes — no browser, no sales call.

toolsPreview.name: get_access_options
toolsPreview.description: Every way to get full access to a Dataplex product: Snowflake Marketplace, Databricks, free trial, docs, human contact.
